name: Skew Step
description: Take a stride with chaos qi thrown wide in the leg so the foot lands a hand's width off the line the foe watches.

name: Askew Palm
description: Thrust a palm whose line wavers at the last instant so it lands where the foe's guard is not.

name: Wobble Guard
description: Let the forearm shake with loose qi so an incoming blow glances away at an angle no one can predict.

name: Veer Kick
description: Start a kick toward one side then swing it to the other as the qi jumps in the hip.

name: Stray Shove
description: Push at the foe's chest with qi that slides sideways and pulls their balance out of true.

name: Slant Turn
description: Spin off the lead foot at an odd angle so the body leaves the line of a straight attack.

name: Scatter Jab
description: Jab with a fist whose qi breaks into small bursts so the single hit lands as several quick knocks.

name: Random Flurry
description: Throw three short blows in no fixed order at the chest and flank and arm of one foe.

name: Loose Hook
description: Swing a hook with a slack arm that tightens only on contact to add a hard snap.

name: Spatter Flick
description: Flick the fingers to throw a spray of chaos qi that stings the face and hands of a close foe.

name: Patchwork Guard
description: Throw both forearms up with qi laid in uneven patches that catch a blow wherever it lands.

name: Scurry Step
description: Take quick short steps of uneven length so the foe cannot find the distance between them.

name: Glancing Elbow
description: Drive an elbow that skips off the raised guard and carries on into the ribs.

name: Knot Sense
description: Open the senses to feel which threads of qi in a body are knotted and which run free.

name: Flux Reading
description: Read the unsteady flow of a foe's qi to guess which arm will move next.

name: Disorder Gauge
description: Judge how stirred and disordered the qi has become around the user to learn where a fight has already churned it.

name: Pattern Probe
description: Touch a foe's guard with a thread of qi and learn which parts of it hold a steady pattern.

name: Muddle Slip
description: Fog the qi around the body so the foe's strike picks the wrong spot and slides away.

name: Stutter Step
description: Hitch the stride in the middle of a pace so the foe's counter arrives before the user is there.

name: Offbeat Strike
description: Land a blow in the gap between two beats of the exchange where the foe does not look for one.

name: Hitch Palm
description: Pause a palm halfway through its course then release it so a foe braced early is struck late.

name: Lurch Chop
description: Drop the body with a sudden lurch and chop at the foe's forearm from below.

name: Dropped Beat
description: Break the cadence of an exchange with one missing beat so the foe's next move reaches nothing.

name: Breath Snap
description: Tap the foe's diaphragm at an uneven moment so their breath catches and their rhythm falls apart.

name: Erratic Guard
description: Sweep the arms through a guard that changes direction each time so no blow finds the same cover twice.

name: Aimless Pace
description: Move in a slow aimless drift that hides the true line of the next step until it is taken.

name: Knot Touch
description: Touch the foe's wrist and twist the thread of their qi into a knot that stiffens the hand.

name: Snarl Grip
description: Close a hand about the foe's forearm and weave chaos qi through it until the arm tangles in itself.

name: Twist Palm
description: Strike with a palm that turns over on landing so the qi corkscrews into the target.

name: Tangled Slip
description: Wind both hands around an incoming arm and turn it aside along a path it did not intend.

name: Muddle Tap
description: Tap the foe's temple with a flicker of chaos qi so their sense of the next move blurs.

name: Plait Step
description: Cross the feet through a weaving path that carries the user round a foe's reach.

name: Fickle Guard
description: Hold a guard whose shape changes from moment to moment so the foe cannot learn where it is thin.

name: Mutable Shield
description: Spread qi over the forearms in a skin that thickens wherever the foe's blows fall.

name: Flicker Block
description: Flick the hands in and out of the line of a blow so it meets only a moving edge of qi.

name: Swerve Arm
description: Bend the arm round a strike with a sudden swerve and push it past the body.

name: Unsteady Cover
description: Throw up a cover of qi that trembles and breaks into sparks so the foe misjudges its strength.

name: Backlash Slap
description: Answer a blocked blow with an open slap whose qi jumps to the guard's open side.

name: Hesitate Step
description: Check one foot above the ground then plant it elsewhere so the foe's strike falls on the old spot.

name: Fray Touch
description: Brush the foe's arm and fray the edge of the qi that runs along it so their grip weakens.

name: Snarl Strike
description: Strike so the qi enters in a snarl and spreads along the foe's meridians in all directions.

name: Ragged Palm
description: Drive a palm with torn and uneven qi that bites at the skin and tugs at the guard.

name: Unthread
description: Pluck at the threads of qi in a foe's stance until the posture comes loose.

name: Splinter Step
description: Break one stride into three small uneven steps that end well to the side of the foe's reach.

name: Wild Burst
description: Loose a short burst of unshaped qi from the palm that flies in a line no one can predict.

name: Random Pulse
description: Send a ragged pulse of chaos qi outward from the body that knocks at everything close at uneven strength.

name: Sputter Shot
description: Fire three weak bolts of qi that sputter out of the fingertips and spread apart in flight.

name: Sprawl Burst
description: Burst the stored qi out of the chest in a sprawl that scatters everything within arm's reach.

name: Reckless Release
description: Let the held qi go from the fist all at once so the blow lands harder than it was aimed.

name: Wild Ward
description: Hold chaos qi in a churning skin about the body that throws back the weakest blows.
